name: Four Seasons Hotel Beijing
insider_take: Where imperial grandeur meets modern luxury in the heart of China's capital
whats_special: Located just steps from the Forbidden City, this Four Seasons occupies prime real estate on Wangfujing Street - Beijing's most prestigious shopping district. The hotel's design seamlessly blends contemporary elegance with traditional Chinese elements, featuring stunning views of the ancient palace complex that few hotels can match.
pro_tip: Book a Forbidden City view room on higher floors for unobstructed sunrise views over the imperial palace - the golden hour lighting on the ancient rooftops is absolutely magical and perfect for photography.
dont_miss: The hotel's spa features traditional Chinese medicine treatments, while Cai Yi Xuan restaurant serves exceptional Cantonese cuisine. Take advantage of being within walking distance of Tiananmen Square, the National Museum, and some of Beijing's best Peking duck restaurants hidden in the nearby hutongs.
pros: Prime location in Chaoyang District with easy access to business and shopping areas
Exceptional service standards with personalized attention and multilingual staff
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities including traditional Chinese treatments
Multiple award-winning dining venues featuring international and authentic Chinese cuisine
cons: Busy urban location with city traffic and noise
